title: The floor has fallen into the dark
description: A shaft opens where the passage should be. Something down there is still dripping.

onPass.narration: The beams hold. On the far ledge lies a strongbox that fell before you did.

onFail.narration: The timber splits underfoot and the company goes down hard on the near lip.

onPass.narration: Hand over hand along the old cut marks. A miner's satchel is still hanging where he left it.

onFail.narration: A handhold crumbles. Nobody falls far, but everybody falls.

choices.text: Go back and find another way round.

onPass.narration: An hour lost to a longer passage. Better an hour than a leg.
